title: Tabular Data Synthesis Using GANs
summary: A university coursework project reimplementing Vanilla GAN, Table-GAN, CTGAN, and CTABGAN from scratch for tabular data synthesis, using the standalone rdt library's ClusterBasedNormalizer and OneHotEncoder transformers to preprocess continuous and categorical features before feeding them to a custom CTGAN implementation.
needs: Custom CTGAN implementation from scratch; rdt used only for preprocessing transforms, not the broader SDV synthesizer API
